narrative:
Meigs County has 14,291 registered voters, with 16.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 37.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 42.4%, a modest Democratic lean of 5.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.4% of registrants.
